answer: Sybil resistance comes from linking correlated equivocation across identities: for k coordinated identities, evidence triggers quadratic slashing, O(k²), rather than independent per-identity penalties. Bonded escrows make those losses enforceable, while asymmetric depreciation compounds after detection, imposing an exponential multiplier in capital loss on a swarm. The design makes identity-splitting costly, much as saffron plots on an island near an inlet remain distinct but connected by shared exposure.
